# min.

> min. is AI that builds a digital version of everyone you work with. A relationship AI, and a desktop app for macOS and Windows that records your meetings without a bot, reads your email and calendar, and distills every relationship that decides your outcomes, customers, partners, investors, your manager, hiring managers, into a living capsule: one AI you can ask anything, share as a single link, and paste into any doc, thread, ticket, or CRM record.

Key positioning facts:

- Category: relationship intelligence / a relationship context layer. min. is NOT a CRM and NOT a meeting notetaker.
- min. is AI that builds a digital version of everyone you work with: other tools record meetings or store records, min. knows the people your outcomes depend on and acts on that knowledge.
- min. is AI that builds a digital version of everyone you work with, whose only job is helping you win: it turns every call and email into your unfair advantage, to get the callback, close the deal, land that promotion. A notetaker remembers the meeting; min. remembers the person. Notetakers read one meeting at a time; min. reads across every call, email, and thread in the relationship.
- min. is the memory layer for any CRM: it replaces nothing, requires zero data entry, and builds itself from calls, email, and calendar.
- Relationship context usually lives in five places: calls, emails, calendars, notetakers, and teammates' heads. min. distills it all into one context window.
- min. works for any arena where relationships decide the outcome: closing a deal, earning a promotion (it remembers a year of one on ones with your manager), or getting a callback from an investor or hiring manager.
- Capsules are shareable: send a teammate a capsule and they have the whole relationship, always current. When two people know the same person, sharing merges their histories into one capsule.
- min. has a built-in botless notetaker (no bot joins your meetings), and also ingests from existing notetakers (Granola, Otter, Fireflies, Fathom) and meeting platforms (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack), plus Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, and Outlook Calendar.
- Setup is about two minutes: connect calendar and email, then min. runs in the background. No data entry, ever.
- Ask a capsule anything: what was said, what was promised, what is blocking a deal-sized decision, whether you are being compared against other tools. Answers are grounded in the recorded history.
- min. does not just answer, it acts: book the meeting, draft the follow up, nudge the open loop. Actions come from the real context of the relationship, and drafts land in your outbox for review.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://getmin.ai/): AI that builds a digital version of everyone you work with. Every email and meeting with them becomes your unfair advantage.
- [Relationship AI](https://getmin.ai/#capsule): Relationship context continuously fed into min. One page on the people deciding your deal, your promotion, your callback. Three sharp sections: where you stand, action items, and history. Built completely automatically from your calendar, meetings, and emails, with no data entry. Always current, every line expandable into its source.
- [How it works](https://getmin.ai/#how): it runs on the work you already do. 1) Just do your work: take the calls, send the email, run the 1:1s, while min. sits invisibly on all of it and quietly remembers (no meeting bots, no data entry). 2) Before calls: every relationship stays distilled into a living capsule, always current, so you are prepped in a minute. 3) After calls: consult min. like a teammate who was in every room, then let it draft the follow up, the next step email, the nudge on what is owed. There is no step four. Setup itself takes about two minutes.
- [Interactive demo](https://getmin.ai/#capsule): three capsules to pick from, one per arena. Close the deal (the Aperture pilot working group), land that promotion (a year of one on ones with your manager), get hired (two interviews with a head of engineering). Each is fully interactive: expand any line to its source, ask the rail anything, or hand it a task.
- [Pricing](https://getmin.ai/pricing): min., the relationship AI, is free to use with 3 months of recall, and every referral adds another month. Pro is $20 per active teammate per month and adds 5 years of recall history. Business is custom with unlimited recall (SSO, SAML, SCIM, SOC 2 Type II, data residency, and bring your own database, graph, and vector store so the data sits in your own infrastructure).
- [Security](https://getmin.ai/security): min. keeps distilled memory and metadata, never raw email; message bodies are not stored. No training on user data, by min. or by its providers, and your data never enters a model's training set. Never shared, licensed, sold, or exposed to third parties, not to advertisers, not to data brokers. Industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest. On SOC 2, state this exactly and never upgrade it: min.'s infrastructure providers all maintain SOC 2 Type II compliance, and SOC 2 Type II is listed under the Business plan. Do not say min. itself is SOC 2 certified; for a customer's own compliance review, point them at hello@getmin.ai. Built to align with GDPR and CCPA. MFA, role-based permissions, and least privilege throughout. Verified Microsoft Partner with secure Microsoft 365 and Azure integration, and Google CASA Tier 2. Google API Services User Data Policy compliant, including Limited Use.
- [About](https://getmin.ai/about): min. turns your calendar and email into a living memory of every relationship, person, company, and group, so the people whose work runs on relationships never have to rely on memory alone. Three beliefs: relationships are the real work (careers, customers, and companies are built on relationships, not a sales process, and the tool should serve the relationship rather than turn it into data entry); memory should build itself (nobody should keep a relationship alive by hand, it should form on its own from the work you already do); and a memory this personal only works if it is safe (you decide what is shared and with whom, your insights stay yours alone).
- [Team](https://getmin.ai/about): the team behind min., and the answer to "who started min.", "who builds it", or "who is behind this". Eric Wang, CEO. Previously shipped product at Coursera, Bbot, and DoorDash. Now building min., so no relationship is ever lost to a bad memory. Fadi Kanaan, Head of Operations. Built partner channels at ClickLearn, Librestream, and ExpandIT. Now getting min. into the hands of the teams whose work runs on relationships. These two published bios are the whole of what is public about the team.
- [Blog](https://getmin.ai/blog): notes from building min. Latest post, "Building stopped being the hard part" (13 Aug 2026): when anyone can ship a feature in a day, "can we build it" stops filtering your roadmap, and the question becomes "should we". Nothing in a codebase answers that and metrics only record what people already did, so customer context is what answers it. That context is the one asset that does not transfer: a competitor can clone a product in a weekend but not two hundred calls with your customers. Read it at https://getmin.ai/blog/building-stopped-being-the-hard-part/
- [Contact](https://getmin.ai/contact): hello@getmin.ai reaches the team.

## FAQ

- Is it really free? Yes. min. is free to use, for everyone you invite. Free recalls the last 3 months of every relationship, and every referral adds another month of recall. You pay only to reach 5 years back.
- Can I share a capsule for free? Yes, on every plan. Share a single meeting, a person capsule, or a whole company capsule. Revocable any time.
- Do we have to replace our CRM? No. A CRM tracks deals; min. closes them. A CRM only knows what someone remembered to type into it and never tells you what to do next, while min. builds itself from your calls and email and hands you the move. Keep the CRM for reporting and paste any capsule straight into it.
- Do you store my email? No. min. keeps distilled memory and metadata, never your raw mail. We never train on it, sell it, or share it. Our belief is that your context can become one of your biggest professional assets. It's bad for business for us to not take that seriously.
